column2: [From.GetTitledName] has sent an envoy to our court. Bowing exactly as deep as protocol demands and not a hair deeper, the mandarin unrolls a scroll of yellow silk: it is time, it says, for the [From.Offmap.GetFullName] to become our sovereign in name as well as in deed. As the envoy idly strokes his long moustache, his interpreter adds: 'It is only the natural course of things, my [Root.GetLordLady]. The Dragon is patient, but its patience is not without end.'
We would be honoured to serve the great [From.Offmap.GetFullName].
We were wrong to raid your lands. Instead, we shall serve!
[Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName] will not kneel without a fight!
§Y[From.GetTitledName]§! will declare war on you.

Rumours of the might of the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] have proven a weapon in themselves. After the briefest of talks, [cathayan_invasion_target.GetBestName] has agreed to become a tributary of the Dragon Throne. [cathayan_invasion_target.GetHerHisCap] couriers whisper that they can only hope the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap] will prove a generous master.

Not even a realm as great as [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName] dares stand against the full force of the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]. [cathayan_invasion_target.GetBestName] has agreed to become a tributary of the Dragon Throne without a sword drawn. Time will tell whether the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap] truly favours [cathayan_invasion_target.GetHerHim].
So be it.
§Y[cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitledName]§! became a tributary of §Ythe [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§!.

To make us a tributary of the [From.Offmap.GetFullName], [From.GetTitledName] has declared war on us! The Jade Legions are already marching on our realm, and the people of [Root.Capital.GetName] fear a long and bloody struggle if we are not to bend the knee to the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetMediumCathayanEmperorName].

To force [cathayan_invasion_target.GetFullName] into tribute to the [From.Offmap.GetFullName], [From.GetTitledName] has declared war! The Jade Legions are already marching on the realm of [cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitledFirstName], and it may well be the end of [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetAdjective] independence.
Our chance to prove ourselves. Let them come!
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], have mercy on us!
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] see us through this.
This could get ugly...
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] protect them!
May their gods protect them.

[From.GetTitledName] has decreed that the wrath of Heaven shall fall upon us! The Jade Legions march on our lands with their fire-rockets and their great cannon, and the tales of their might already spread fear among our own soldiers. We are soon to face the full fury of the [From.Offmap.GetFullName].

[From.GetTitledName] has decreed that the wrath of Heaven shall fall upon [cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitledName]! The Jade Legions are on the march, and unless [cathayan_invasion_target.GetSheHe] cowers behind the walls of [cathayan_invasion_target.Capital.GetName], the [cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitle] can only hope to stand firm as the full fury of the [From.Offmap.GetFullName] falls on [cathayan_invasion_target.GetHerHis] borders.
Their chance to prove themselves! Fascinating!
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] see them through this.

Word comes from the east: the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] has ordered [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName] to march on our lands and force their false [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] upon us. There can be only one Dragon, and we shall show the pretender of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] that it is [cathayan_invasion_target.GetTitledName].

Word comes from the east: the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] has ordered [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName] to march on [cathayan_invasion_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and bring down the upstart pretender. There can be only one Dragon, and [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] means to prove by force that it is [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHim].
Only one can be Lord of Ten Thousand Years.

The turmoil in the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName] has stirred the Hung of the eastern steppe. [the_cathayan_invader.GetFirstName], a warlord of the [the_cathayan_invader.Culture.GetName] who wears the marks of the Dark Gods, has gathered a horde of riders and turned them west. Wherever [the_cathayan_invader.GetSheHe] goes, the steppe burns, and the herders pray that someone will deal with the raiders...

The fall of the House of [previousEmperor.GetOnlyDynastyName] has scattered its children. Cut off from the succession, Prince [the_cathayan_invader.GetFirstName] seeks a new future west of the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName], with what gold [the_cathayan_invader.GetSheHe] could carry and a band of loyal soldiers. They say raiding and looting follow in [the_cathayan_invader.GetHerHis] footsteps...

The civil war in Cathay has been crushed by the armies of the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress], but one of the rebel generals, [the_cathayan_invader.GetTitledFirstName], has fled west with his soldiers. He says that the House of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetOnlyDynastyName] has lost the Mandate of Heaven, that he is the true Son of Heaven, and that he will found an empire of his own.
How unsettling...

More news of [rebel_general.GetTitledFirstName]. He and his soldiers march with all haste towards [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and the rumours say he has chosen my lands as the cradle of his new empire.
He shall get no easy fight here!

The traders bring word that [rebel_general.GetTitledFirstName] was run down by the armies of the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]. His rebels never stood a chance against the well-supplied and loyal soldiers of the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress], and his household has paid for his treason with their heads.
So much for the threats of [rebel_general.GetTitledFirstName].

With the death of [From.GetTitledFirstName], [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has fallen into ruin. No heir was fit to take up the mantle of Son of Heaven and Lord of Ten Thousand Years, and the empire has broken apart. Its vassals rejoice, free of the grasp of the [From.GetEmperorEmpress].\nFar in the east, it is said that [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] is well pleased, for once more there is only one Dragon.

With the defeat of [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] at the hands of [From.GetTitledFirstName], [FromFrom.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has been torn apart. Its vassals rejoice, free of the grasp of the [FromFrom.GetTitle].\nFar in the east, it is said that [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] is well pleased, for once more [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] has shown the might of the Dragon.
They were no match for the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName].

[offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] is no longer the only Dragon. General [From.GetOnlyDynastyName] [From.GetBirthName] has finished [From.GetHerHis] conquest and crowned [From.GetHerselfHimself] [From.GetTitledName]! [From.GetSheHeCap] claims to be the true Son of Heaven and Lord of Ten Thousand Years.\nThe traders from the east say the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] is beside [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerselfHimself] with rage at this pretender. The future of the new [From.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName] is uncertain, but no one can argue with what [From.GetTitledFirstName] has won.
And now we bow to a dragon.
And now they bow to a dragon.

With the death of [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName], [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is in disarray. Many at court urge me to keep to the [FromFrom.Culture.GetName] ways, as my [FromFrom.GetRootRelation] intended, but I am not so sure.
I will take up the [FromFrom.Culture.GetName] ways.
No. The days of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] ended with my [FromFrom.GetRootRelation].

[offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] has sat on the Dragon Throne and looked down on us for too long! The House of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetOnlyDynastyName] is not fit to rule, and we shall tame the Dragon!
I have sent a great part of our army east to strike at the heart of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName], and in answer the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] has commanded [From.GetTitledFirstName] to strike back at [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName].
Tens of thousands of soldiers loyal to the Son of Heaven march on us.
The days of the House of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetOnlyDynastyName] are numbered!

Weary of how [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] sits on the Dragon Throne and looks down on the world, [FromFrom.GetBestName] has resolved to tame the Dragon!\n[FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] has sent part of [FromFrom.GetHerHis] army east to invade the heartland of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] and claim it for [FromFromFrom.GetBestName], while the rest stays behind to meet the counterattack of [From.GetTitledFirstName].
Grand Cathay shall belong to the House of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName]!
Will [FromFrom.GetSheHe] tame the Dragon?

The armies of [From.GetBestName] have prevailed! The soldiers of [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] are scattered and the war in the east is over. The former [offmap_cathay.PrevRuler.GetEmperorEmpress], [offmap_cathay.PrevRuler.GetOnlyDynastyName] [offmap_cathay.PrevRuler.GetBirthName], has been cast down, and in [offmap_cathay.PrevRuler.GetHerHis] place [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] now rules!\nThe House of [From.GetOnlyDynastyName] has conquered the east and reigns supreme. The gates of the Great Bastion are thrown open to its kin and allies.\nGlory to the new [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress]!
And so a new Dragon rises.

The armies of [From.GetBestName] have been defeated! Across the heartland of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] they were cut down in skirmish after skirmish by the soldiers of the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress].\nIn the west, too, the armies of [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] have prevailed, putting an end to this foolish invasion and tearing down [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] once and for all.
And so the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetOnlyDynastyName] Dragon endures.

Whispers from the east say that [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetLongCathayanEmperorName] is in a joyous mood, for the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetAdjective] claimant, [invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetBestName], is dead.\n[invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetHerHisCap] death has broken the spirit of the [From.Culture.GetName] armies, who now march home to [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName].\nLike [invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetBestName], the invasion of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] has come to its end.
Perhaps the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmperorEmpress] sent assassins?
Not only have I lost [invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetFirstName], but this war as well!
An Expedition East

My captains are gathered and my armies are ready to cross the eastern edge of the world. Before we march, they want to know what we are going for. Cathay has more of everything than any realm in the west, and we cannot carry it all home.
Gold, jade and silk!
Slaves, as many as we can drive home.
Force the Dragon Throne to deal with us.
Their scholars, their star charts, their secrets.
On second thought, not yet.
[From.GetBestName] has marched across the eastern edge of the world to plunder Grand Cathay. The armies of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] are gathering to meet [From.GetHerHim].
[From.GetBestName] has marched on Grand Cathay to carry off its people in chains. The armies of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] are gathering to meet [From.GetHerHim].

[From.GetBestName] has marched on Grand Cathay to force the Dragon Throne to treat with [From.GetHerHim] as an equal. The armies of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] are gathering to meet [From.GetHerHim].

[From.GetBestName] has marched on Grand Cathay in search of its libraries, its observatories and its engineers. The armies of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] are gathering to meet [From.GetHerHim].
Let them try their luck against the Dragon.
The expedition of [From.GetBestName] has come home from Cathay with wagons groaning under jade, silk and silver. The Dragon Throne is said to have sworn vengeance.
The expedition of [From.GetBestName] has come home from Cathay driving long columns of captives before it. The Dragon Throne is said to have sworn vengeance.
The expedition of [From.GetBestName] has won its war, and the Dragon Throne has been forced to open its borders and to receive [From.GetHerHis] envoys with honour.
The expedition of [From.GetBestName] has come home from Cathay with scrolls, star charts and scholars. What they know will soon be known across [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName].
So the Dragon can bleed.

[From.GetBestName] has turned the hordes of the Ruinous Powers east, against the Great Bastion itself. At their head rides [invasion_of_cathay_claimant.GetBestName], who has sworn to cast down the Dragon Emperor and sit on the Dragon Throne in the name of the Dark Gods.
May the Bastion hold.

Sails have been sighted, and then banners: red silk and gold dragons. The [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] has heard that its children in the west are beset, and an army of the Dragon Throne has come ashore at [Root.Capital.GetName] to fight under my command until the war is won.

Merchants on the Silk Road report that [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] has sent an army west to defend the Cathayan colonists of [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. The Dragon Throne does not forget its own, however far from home they have settled.

A fleet of junks has arrived from the east, carrying farmers, craftsmen and scribes sent by the Dragon Throne to strengthen its colonies. They bring seed, tools, and a chest of silver from the imperial treasury.

An envoy of [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] has come to my court with a scroll sealed in jade. The Dragon Throne demands that I hand over [cathay_hunted_exile.GetBestName], who fled the justice of the Dragon Throne and now lives under my roof. The envoy did not say what will happen if I refuse. He did not need to.

Word has come that [cathay_hunted_exile.GetBestName], who fled the justice of the Dragon Throne, has been found dead. Nobody saw the killers come or go. In the bazaars along the Silk Road they say that [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitledFirstName] has very long arms.

They came at night, quiet as cats, with blades of black jade. My guards cut down two of them before they reached my chamber. None carried anything that names a master, but I know who sent them. The Dragon Throne has not forgiven me.
The Dragon Sends Aid
Settlers from Cathay
A Demand from the Dragon Throne
Hidden Blades
Glory to the Dragon Throne!
Settle them near [Root.Capital.GetName].
Hand [cathay_hunted_exile.GetFirstName] over to the envoy.
The east does not forget.
Double the guard.
My guests are under my protection.

My council brings word that the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] of Grand Cathay has sent a host to aid [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] servants in the west. Jade Warriors in lacquered armour, peasant longbowmen by the thousand, sky lanterns drifting above the column like a second, burning sky. They have come down the long road from the Great Bastion, and they have come for us. Leaning over the war table, I can only hope my silence gives my captains courage. In my own chest I feel the panic rising.

Through a year of careful planning, hard fighting and luck enough to make believers of us all, we have broken the Dragon's host. I was almost beginning to dream of victory when the scouts came in from the east. The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] has sent another army down the road. Smaller, they say. It does not look small from the walls.
May [Root.TrueReligion.GetHighGodName] help us...
What does it take to bring down this beast?!
An imperial host of Grand Cathay has arrived in §Y[spawn_province.GetName]§!.

The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies are falling back at last, after a bloody war with [the_winner.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [the_winner.GetTitledName] has shown the world that [the_winner.GetHerHis] leadership must be reckoned with. The defeat will be remembered in the halls of the Celestial Empire, and certainly by the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap], who does not forget.

When [the_winner.Culture.GetName] armies first clashed with the Cathayan regiments, few expected this ending. The Jade Warriors fought well, but they are marching home in sullen silence, for the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] has lost its war against [the_winner.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [the_winner.GetTitledFirstName]'s name is spoken in every caravanserai along the Ivory Road.
The [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] will remember our name!
And so the Dragon recoils...
§YThe [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! lost a war against §Y[the_winner.GetTitledName]§!.

The people of [the_loser.PrimaryTitle.GetName] hang their heads, for their lords have come home with terrible news. Since [the_loser.GetHerHis] order to attack, [the_loser.GetTitledName] has suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]. Meanwhile the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies light their lanterns in celebration, and the Dragon's banners fly over the passes.

The people of [the_loser.PrimaryTitle.GetName] will likely never learn why the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap] chose to turn [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] gaze on [the_loser.GetTitledFirstName]. Whatever the reason, they have suffered a crushing defeat, and the [offmap_cathay.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies are marching home along the long roads east, laden with tribute.
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] watch over us.
The Dragon is not to be toyed with...
§YThe [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! won a war against §Y[the_loser.GetTitledName]§!.

The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetEmpressEmperorCap] must have weightier matters to attend to than the war with [the_aggressor.GetTitledName]. Perhaps the hordes of the north press on the Great Bastion again. Why else would the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] treat with those who attacked it? The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.Culture.GetName] armies are said to be marching home.

When the [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] sent its armies into [the_defender.PrimaryTitle.GetName], few expected the war to end in a stalemate. The Cathayan regiments are turning back, and the court of [the_defender.GetTitledName] is working night and day to calm the people of [the_defender.Capital.GetName], who still look east at every dust cloud on the road.
We survived the wrath of the Dragon...
Not all who face the Dragon live to tell of it.
§YThe [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! made a white peace with §Y[the_aggressor.GetTitledName]§!.
§YThe [offmap_cathay.GetFullName]§! made a white peace with §Y[the_defender.GetTitledName]§!.

My council brings word from the coast. Sails were seen at dawn, ribbed sails the colour of old blood, and by noon the harbour of [spawn_province.GetName] was full of war junks of Grand Cathay, the fleet of Yin-Yin the Sea Dragon, out of Fu-Chow across half the world. The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] has sent a host by sea to aid [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] servants in the west: Jade Warriors in lacquered armour, peasant longbowmen by the thousand, sky lanterns lifted off the decks. Leaning over the war table, I can only hope my silence gives my captains courage. In my own chest I feel the panic rising.

Through a year of careful planning, hard fighting and luck enough to make believers of us all, we have broken the Dragon's host. I was almost beginning to dream of victory when the riders came in from the coast. More junks in the harbour of [spawn_province.GetName], more banners on the quays. The [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetTitle] has sent another army over the sea. Smaller, they say. It does not look small from the walls.
An imperial host of Grand Cathay has landed in §Y[spawn_province.GetName]§!.
The war bands we sent over the border of [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] have come home for good. We cannot send them out again for now.
We shall ride east another day.
Our raiders are back from [offmap_cathay.GetFullName], dusty and laughing, their saddlebags heavy with copper cash, bolts of silk and the rice of the border villages they burned.
Bring the spoils to me!

On their way home our raiders fell upon a caravan on the road to Wei-Jin, a long line of carts loaded with silk, porcelain and jade. The guards fled at the first arrow. [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] smiles on the bold!
Fantastic! Bring it all to me!
Our raiders have outdone themselves. Near the border they caught a mandarin of the Jade Court travelling in disguise, and his house paid a fortune in gold, silk and porcelain to see him home again.
The treasures of [offmap_cathay.GetShortName] shall all be mine!

Our raiders never reached the villages. The terracotta sentinels and the crossbows of a border fort cut them to pieces in a mountain pass. A single survivor came home, and he does nothing but tell the tale of their defeat.
Curse it! This must be the work of [Root.Religion.GetRandomEvilGodName]...

Our raiders came home by way of a mandarin's country house. Besides gold and silk they brought me a more personal prize: [cathayraid_captive.GetFullName], who is probably the [cathayraid_captive.GetSonDaughter] of the house.
A stunning beauty!
A fine hostage!
I shall make [cathayraid_captive.GetHerHim] my concubine.

This time our raiders broke into the workshop of a famous Cathayan siege engineer, where gunpowder rockets and great crossbows are made for the Dragon's armies. The master escaped, but they dragged one of his apprentices west: [cathayraid_engineer.GetFullName] will now serve me.
A siege engineer of my own? Excellent!
Make him a commander at once.
Dismiss a commander if needed to make room for the siege engineer.

Our raiders looted a shrine of the Celestial Dragons in a border town. Most of what they brought back is gold and incense, but the priests had hidden one piece in the temple vault: a true treasure of Grand Cathay.
A treasure of Cathay? Bring it to me!
You gain a treasure of Cathay. Such a prize comes only once in a lifetime.
Our raiders have brought back a pair of... bears? The black and white beasts are not fierce at all, and spend most of their time chewing bamboo and tumbling about. They will make grand pets!
Prepare an enclosure!

[cathayraid_viceroy.GetTitledName], Jade Viceroy of the West, writes to the marauding [Root.GetTitledName].\n\nThe Celestial Dragon Emperor has seen your bandits on his roads and in his villages. Heaven is patient, but it does not forget. Call back your dogs, or the armies of [offmap_cathay.GetFullName] will come to call them back for you.
I am not afraid of empty threats!
Despite every effort to make them breed, our pandas have died without young. Truly a sorrowful day...
Oh well.
Not my cuddly friends! How could you leave me?

The §Y[Root.Offmap.GetFullName]§! is overburdened with riches. Why beg the Emperor for grace when we can just take what we want?\n\nWhile we raid, all §YPay Tribute§! and §YAsk for Boon§! interactions are §Rdisabled§!, and stay so for five years after the raids end. We lose grace every month and part of our levies is away, but our raiders bring home loot every year. Only lords near the roads east can reach Cathay.
